---
title: "Geospatial Analyses"
subtitle: "Wasatch Front Regional Council"
---

A working index of ad hoc geospatial analyses for WFRC. Each analysis
lives in its own folder under `projects/`, with its own data sources,
script/notebook, and outputs. See `README.md` and `CLAUDE.md` at the repo
root for conventions.

To start a new analysis, copy `projects/_template/` (its underscore prefix
keeps it -- and any other in-progress scaffold folder -- out of this
published site by convention).

## [Center Buildout Capacity](projects/center-buildout-capacity/index.qmd)

Current homes and jobs, REMM's 2055 forecast, and full buildout capacity
for six Wasatch Choice Vision centers: Daybreak, Saratoga Springs
Downtown, The Point, Ogden Downtown, Clearfield, and Farmington Station
Park.
